summary: Tested iter28 white-label branding fixes. Backend enrichment of /api/public/review-info with salon_name+salon_location works perfectly for both tenants (4/4 pytest pass). Frontend: Dashboard heading, login toast, AppLayout header, POS receipt brand, and public review page (/review/:id) header + footer all correctly reflect the tenant name. ONE CRITICAL BUG FOUND: Appointments → Send Review Link WhatsApp text is STILL hardcoded to 'Miracurl' (Appointments.jsx line 102) — Elegance tenant sends 'Thank you for visiting Miracurl today' which leaks the parent brand. Bug confirmed via E2E interception of window.open.

ui_bugs.issue: WhatsApp review-link message hardcodes 'Miracurl' instead of tenant.name. Elegance owner clicking Send Review Link produces: 'Hi <name> ✦ Thank you for visiting Miracurl today!'. tenant is already destructured from useAuth() at line 30 but never used in this function. Fix: replace 'Miracurl' on line 102 with ${tenant?.name || 'us'}.

action_items: Fix Appointments.jsx line 102: change hardcoded 'Miracurl' to `${tenant?.name || 'us'}` inside the sendReviewLink msg template. tenant is already available via useAuth() at line 30.
critical_code_review_comments: Appointments.jsx line 102 is the only remaining hardcoded 'Miracurl' leak in customer-facing salon UI — a copy-paste oversight; the fix is trivial (2-char change).

AppLayout sidebar shows 'MIRACURL / Salon Suite' logo for both tenants — this appears intentional (parent SaaS brand per review request 'other_misc_info') but worth double-checking with product: when a salon is fully white-labelled on custom domain, some owners may want their OWN logo in the sidebar too. Not this iteration's scope.
server.py still at 2720 lines — carried over from iter27, should be split into routers.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Service, TEST_Stylist, TEST_WhiteLabel customer, and one completed appointment under the Elegance tenant to enable send-review-link testing. These have TEST_ prefixes for easy cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend review-info enrichment verified via /app/backend/tests/test_iter28_whitelabel.py — parametrized over both tenants, both return correct salon_name+salon_location. Frontend confirmed via Playwright: Dashboard heading uses tenant.name correctly ('Welcome back to Miracurl Unisex Family Salon ✦' and 'Welcome back to Elegance Beauty Lounge ✦'); login toast is generic 'Welcome back ✦'; AppLayout header subtitle shows tenant.name+location; public /review/:id page shows correct salon_name in review-brand testid AND footer '© Elegance Beauty Lounge · Koramangala, Bangalore'. Only failure: Appointments sendReviewLink line 102 hardcoded 'Miracurl'. After main agent fixes that one line, this whole iteration is green — no need to retest anything else.

rca of the issue: sendReviewLink() in /app/frontend/src/pages/Appointments.jsx destructures {tenant} from useAuth() at line 30 (so main agent clearly intended to use it), but line 102's template literal hardcodes 'Miracurl' instead of ${tenant?.name}.
